text:
maria_cs: quick capture from today's Northgrid onboarding call — paste of raw asks below. TL;DR: three product gaps + an enablement request. they flagged renewal convo in 6 weeks and said these would impact adoption :eyes:

maria_cs: pain 1 — embeddings staleness: they ship nightly data but embeddings only refresh on manual re-ingest. they want either incremental embedding refresh or a lightweight webhook that triggers re-embed on row change. they called this a blocker for their search accuracy metric (~20% drop).

maria_cs: pain 2 — per-route cost visibility: PM asked for a simple per-route cost breakdown in the console (they run 8 routes). current token-level UI is too noisy for their finance team. asked for an exportable CSV and annotations for spikes.

maria_cs: pain 3 — private model rollout: security team needs a staged allowlist for model variants (canary -> baseline -> locked). they want an API to pin routes to model tags during rollout.

maria_cs: enablement ask — they asked for a "jumpstart" onboarding doc: 1-pager checklist + sample scripts for embedding refresh and cost export. suggested we include a one-click terraform snippet or curl examples.

maria_cs: pasted quote from their PM: "If we can see cost per route and automate embedding refresh, we can double our calls without raising internal alarms. otherwise it's a hard sell to infra."

nina_csm: adding notes to Northgrid account — will surface in renewal tracker. tagging @sam_product for prioritization, @kevin_eng for feasibility. :pushpin:

sam_product: thanks — useful capture. quick thoughts: 1) per-route CSV export seems low effort (backend already aggregates tokens by route), 2) embedding webhook needs infra thought (we could add a webhook event that enqueues a re-embed job), 3) model-rollout pinning overlaps with canary rollout work but route-level pin is new.

kevin_eng: +1 on CSV export being low effort. webhook for re-embed — main questions: auth and rate limits. Do we let customers post a row id -> re-embed endpoint or provide a signing token?

jonah_solutions: can prototype a sample curl + terraform snippet for the jumpstart doc. i'll scope a minimal example that uses the current embeddings API and a small lambda that triggers on DB change.

maria_cs: can we get a quick triage? Northgrid is mid-market, paying, renewal in 6w. if product needs a formal request, i can open a JIRA but wanted quick pulse here.

sam_product: let's classify asks: (A) per-route cost export — engineering quickwin, (B) embedding refresh webhook — medium, needs infra design, (C) route->model pin for private — larger, requires rollout/console work. propose: ship A as a patch in next sprint, scope B for a one month spike, and draft a spec for C for Q2.

kevin_eng: agree. i'll put a 3-day spike for B to validate auth model. if spike succeeds we estimate 2-3 sprints to implement full feature.

nina_csm: thanks team. i'll tell Northgrid we can deliver route CSV in ~2 weeks and will follow up on embed webhook timeline.

ops_bot: deploy reminder: product sprint planning meeting is tomorrow 10:00am PT — add agenda item: "Northgrid cost/export + embedding webhook spike".

sam_product: perfect. @maria_cs pls open a short ticket per ask (label: cs-customer-ask, priority: P2 for A, P1 for B if renewal risk increases).

maria_cs: on it. will paste ticket IDs here once created. :thumbsup:
